title: Re: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Fire Mutants
description: Re: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Fire Mutants — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls again in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls again in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

The secret is there, you just have to research harder. By research I mean slay, slay, slay like there is no tomorrow! I need a new edge for my business and I have a good feeling that this Nesting Doll magic is my next big break. Will you go back in and see if you can figure out how they do their nesting doll trick?

Hunt down the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls for me again in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5. Slay the Fire Mutant Nesting dolls and see if you learn anything more about the precious and magical creatures that you have just destroyed. Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you have finished this quest.

Turn-in:

Learn anything new? Hmmm. Maybe slaying these creatures is not the right way to figure out their secrets? Hahahaha! Yeah, that was a good one! Let me know when you want to do this again.

Objectives:

  • Slay Fire Mutant Hulk Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Puker Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Twins Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Unipsycho Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Pincer Nesting Doll

Level range: 85–100
